seed: Create standard SME chart of accounts

import.prompt: Name of the chart of accounts
import.orphans: Without a valid parent account (placed directly under the chart):
import.duplicates: Duplicate account numbers (only the first was kept):
import.invalid: The file does not have the expected format. Expected columns: Nummer, Name, Gruppe and Kontoart.

select.hint: Please select a chart of accounts first.

okey.label: okey
okey.helper: The okey is the key of an element, consisting of the prefix of the category and a sequential number, e.g. boat-001 for the first boat.

id.label: Account no.
id.helper: The unique number of the account.
id.duplicate: This account number is already used in the chart of accounts.

name.label: Account name
name.error: The name is mandatory and must consist of alphanumeric characters.
name.helper: A name can consist of several words. Only letters (incl. -) and numbers are allowed, no special characters.

bank.label: Bank account
bank.description: An account held at a bank.

user.label: User account
user.description: A personal account of a user.

root.label: Chart of accounts
root.description: The root of a chart of accounts.

group.label: Account group
group.description: Groups further groups or accounts together.

leaf.label: Account
leaf.description: An account that bookings are posted to.

parentKey.label: Parent account
parentKey.helper: The parent account is the group this account belongs to. It decides where the account appears in the chart of accounts.

kind.label: Account kind
kind.helper: The account kind follows from the parent account and is written to the export.

deleteConf.tree: Really delete «{name}» and the {count} accounts below it?
deleteConf.inUse: «{name}» cannot be deleted: this account (or one below it) is already booked on — {count} booking lines. Please reassign those bookings first.
